notes.title: Electrogical - Patch Notes - v1.1.2 (2025/3/12 JST)

notes.title: Electrogical - Patch Notes - v1.0.4 (2024/11/30 JST)

We have made updates to the Early Access version.


 Fixed an issue where sliding pieces would go off the rails.
 Fixed an issue where the ranking button on the puzzle screen did not respond.


If a sliding piece has already gone off the rails

 Press the reset button.
 If the board is saved, delete the saved data (use the trash can icon in the upper-left corner).

notes.title: Electrogical - Patch Notes - v1.0.2 (2024/11/27 JST)

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Electrogical - Patch Notes - v1.0.1 (2024/11/25 JST)
notes.notes:
We’ve made some updates to the Early Access version:


 You can now zoom in and out on the map using the mouse wheel.
 Right-clicking a piece will return it to its default position.
 When the goal piece’s value doesn’t match the calculated value, the current value displayed on the goal piece will now flash. This makes it easier to compare the goal value with the calculated value.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
